description: Read what became of a transfer draft you sealed, by draft_id: its status, the transfer_id once COMMITTED, and refusal_reason when REFUSED. Moves no money and sends nothing. Use it only when the user asks whether a transfer went through; never poll it in a loop. Report each status this way: COMMITTED means sent. COMMITTING means Lovie is sending it right now: never send it again and never tell the user it failed. REFUSED, ABANDONED and EXPIRED mean not sent. APPROVAL_REQUESTED means it is not sent yet: Lovie is waiting for or confirming the approval on the phone, so never tell the user it failed and never ask them to approve again. OPEN means the phone approval was never requested. Without a draft_id, find the draft with list_open_transfer_drafts and include_recently_closed set.
name: get_transfer_draft_outcome
title: Get Mcp Transfer Draft Transfer
